question: Diabetes mellitus type MODY (maturityonset diabetes of the young) is characterized by all the following EXCEPT:

options.opa: It is an autosomal dominant disorder.
options.opb: It is characterized by a genetic defect in the function of beta cells of the pancreas.
options.opc: Share the same HLA risk as Diabetes Mellitus type 1.
options.opd: The patients have a slight fasting hyperglycemia.
options.ope: They may need treatment with insulin for their control.
